en.heading: What I work on
en.intro: My work focuses on the evaluation, alignment and post-training of large language models.

themes.title: Validity of probes on model internals

en.outro: The five accepted papers above are all on the evaluation side. My work on training itself is still small-scale: fewer than 200 preference pairs per adapter, one algorithm, one A100 GPU. Taking that part to full research scale is what I want to do in a PhD.

zh.heading: 我在做什么
zh.intro: 研究工作围绕大语言模型的评测、对齐与后训练展开。

themes.title: 预测任务中的信息泄漏与混淆因素

zh.outro: 上面五篇已录用论文都是评测层面的工作。训练方面的工作目前规模还小：每个适配器不到 200 个偏好对、一种算法、一张 A100。读博期间，我希望把这部分扩展到真正的研究规模。
